findings.evidence: `PDF.valenceNumber_chargeConj` at Parton/PDF/ChargeConjugation.lean:183 (`valenceNumber (chargeConj f) i Q2 = -valenceNumber f i Q2`); `PDF.valenceNumber_speciesIsospinConj` at Parton/PDF/Isospin.lean:214 (`= valenceNumber f (Equiv.swap u d i) Q2`); grep for `valenceNumber_speciesIsospinConj` across `code/` returns only its declaration and the docstring line 56.
findings.fix: Replace the proof by `conv_lhs => rw [piPlus_eq_chargeConj_speciesIsospinConj hC hI hb]` then `rw [PDF.valenceNumber_chargeConj, PDF.valenceNumber_speciesIsospinConj, Equiv.swap_apply_right]`.
findings.issue: `valenceNumber_piPlus_d_eq_neg_u` re-derives the valence-number relation from `PDF.mellinMoment_congr` and the two species equalities, instead of transporting `piPlus_eq_chargeConj_speciesIsospinConj` through the existing `PDF.valenceNumber_chargeConj` and the PR's own `PDF.valenceNumber_speciesIsospinConj`. The latter is advertised as a main statement of `Parton/PDF/Isospin.lean` but has no consumer in the repo.

findings.evidence: `chargeConj_valenceModelPdf` proof at Meson/Pdf/Basic.lean:349 uses `PDF.chargeConj_weight, PDF.chargeConj_eq_comap, PDF.comap_modelPdf, chargeConj_valenceModelWeight`; `PDF.comap_modelPdf` at Parton/PDF/Model.lean:110; `speciesIsospinConj_weight` at Parton/PDF/Isospin.lean:189, with no occurrence elsewhere in `code/`.
findings.fix: Mirror `chargeConj_valenceModelPdf`: `rw [valenceModelPdf, valenceModelPdf, PDF.speciesIsospinConj_weight, PDF.speciesIsospinConj_eq_comap, PDF.comap_modelPdf, isospinConj_valenceModelWeight]`.
findings.issue: `isospinConj_valenceModelPdf` is proved by unfolding to `PDF.modelPdf_apply` pointwise, bypassing `PDF.speciesIsospinConj_weight` and `PDF.comap_modelPdf`; the parallel `chargeConj_valenceModelPdf` uses exactly that structural route. `PDF.speciesIsospinConj_weight` consequently has no consumer.

summary: No duplicated or replaceable declarations: Species.map, PDF.speciesIsospinConj and the meson-level isospin material have no existing counterpart in EpsilonEridani, Mathlib, Physlib or TauCeti. But two proofs re-derive results from the integral definition instead of using the transport lemmas this PR itself adds, leaving PDF.valenceNumber_speciesIsospinConj and PDF.speciesIsospinConj_weight with no consumer.
